scope: governance lessons only; these are not scientific evidence and they changed no outcome, because every affected run was stopped before the affected calls were made

lessons.pattern: a check compared a value to itself and could never fail
lessons.where_found: D3-B target schedule audit (schema compared to itself)
lessons.resolution: replaced with a real comparison against the frozen schema

lessons.pattern: a literal-typed comparison the compiler proves cannot fail
lessons.where_found: D3 REV4 gate audit and D3-B target runner
lessons.resolution: values widened to string/number so the assertion stays falsifiable, plus a new check that the two constants differ

lessons.pattern: an audit encoded the defective state as a PASS
lessons.where_found: the target request kept the subject block and the audit recorded target_subject_data_untouched: true
lessons.resolution: REV5: violation recorded, corrected request frozen, invalid artifact retained uncalled

lessons.pattern: a state-blind instrument's request carried CharacterOS subject state
lessons.resolution: REV5 rebuilt on the state-blind base

lessons.pattern: a noise pilot used the treatment request
lessons.resolution: REV3: non-target frozen request, reused never re-rendered

lessons.pattern: an r-extension mapping paired with a unanimity scorer
lessons.resolution: REV4: stability gate; the extension branch retired prospectively

lessons.pattern: a verdict name understates what the instrument measured
lessons.resolution: recorded in the naming audit; no rename

lessons.pattern: no rule for how an invalid trial enters the denominator
lessons.where_found: D2 A1 pilot; D2-A1 state experiment
lessons.resolution: REV1.1c, REV1.1d and REV1.1e froze them before the affected calls

lessons.pattern: a mapping keyed by a count whose definition the rule never supplied
lessons.resolution: REV1.1d and D3 REV2 defined the counted quantity and the tie verdict

lessons.pattern: a check substituted a value equal to the frozen one, so genuine forgery would pass
lessons.resolution: the check now flips the arm to its opposite

lessons.pattern: a lexical law scoped to the whole request, including inherited production text, making an instrument unimplementable
lessons.resolution: law scoped to the stage's own artifact, plus a no-introduction delta for what it inherits

lessons.pattern: recomputing a frozen hash with a different payload convention than the producer used produces a FALSE integrity failure
lessons.where_found: this closure round: D1 hashes { dataset } while D2/D3 hash { name, content }, so hashing D1 the D2 way reported a mismatch
lessons.resolution: each line is recomputed with its own producer convention; the failure report was withdrawn and the near-miss recorded here
lessons.the_wrong_fix_to_avoid: adjusting the recorded value, or the artifact, to match a recomputation that used the wrong convention

lessons.pattern: an audit check satisfied by another stage's artifact, clearing a stage that had nothing
lessons.resolution: checks made stage-specific by id and by meaning-map shape

retrospective_effect: NONE — every affected run was invalidated or corrected BEFORE the affected calls were made; no scientific output was altered
